title: Spear Trims
description: Trim your spear like your armor
body:
## **Installation Instructions**  
Place the datapack in both the `datapacks` and `resourcepacks` folders.

## **Overview**  
This datapack / resource pack adds support for **weapon trim patterns** on spears.  
It also attempts to resolve the **z-fighting issue** caused by composite mapping, which currently results in misalignment and flickering between the trim pattern and the spear layer.

![How 2 Trim:](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f360a3dba37eb1ac568ad3fec8fd7ccc89c2164a.png)

---

A spear trim pack independently extracted from the [ICT Server(Non-profit)](https://www.incrafttime.top/) weapon trim addon
